1. PLACING AN ORDER

Nailogy Shop UK welcomes orders of all sizes, with no minimum order value required.

All orders are subject to product availability and payment authorisation.

We reserve the right to refuse or cancel an order for legitimate reasons, including stock unavailability, pricing errors, payment issues or suspected fraudulent activity.

If payment has already been received for a cancelled order, a full refund will be issued to the original payment method.

2. PRICING

All prices displayed on our website are in British Pounds Sterling (GBP).

We make every effort to maintain accurate and competitive prices. However, prices may change due to supplier costs, market conditions or product availability.

Nailogy Shop UK reserves the right to update prices without prior notice. Any price changes will not affect orders already accepted.

The final order total, including applicable taxes and delivery charges, will be displayed at checkout.

Current prices are available at www.nailogy.co.uk.

3. PRODUCT DETAILS AND SPECIFICATIONS

Nailogy Shop UK offers professional manicure and pedicure products, tools, accessories and equipment.

We make every effort to provide accurate product descriptions, images and specifications based on information supplied by manufacturers.

Please note:

  • Product colours may vary slightly depending on screen settings.
  • Packaging and product specifications may change according to manufacturer updates.
  • Product availability may vary.
  • Certain products are intended for professional use only.

We reserve the right to update product information where necessary.

If an ordered product is unavailable, we may offer a suitable alternative. Substitutions will only be made with the customer’s agreement.

Customers are responsible for following the manufacturer’s instructions and ensuring products are suitable for their intended use.

4. DELIVERY PRICING

Nailogy Shop UK offers delivery services across the United Kingdom.

Standard Delivery (Royal Mail Tracked 48): £3.99, estimated 2–3 working days after dispatch.

Express Delivery (Royal Mail Tracked 24): £7.99, estimated 1–2 working days after dispatch.

FREE Standard Delivery: on UK orders over £150

Delivery charges are calculated and displayed during checkout.

Delivery services and prices may be updated when necessary.

5. DELIVERY INFORMATION

We aim to process and dispatch orders as efficiently as possible.

Delivery estimates are provided as guidance and may vary depending on courier services, public holidays, weather conditions or other circumstances beyond our reasonable control.

Customers must ensure that the delivery address provided at checkout is accurate and complete.

Once an order has been dispatched, tracking information will be provided where available.

Customers are encouraged to inspect their parcels upon delivery and report any visible damage or delivery discrepancies promptly.

Your statutory rights regarding delivery remain unaffected.

6. MISSING OR DAMAGED GOODS

We carefully prepare and package all orders to minimise the risk of damage during transportation.

If your order arrives damaged, incomplete or contains incorrect items, please contact us as soon as possible, preferably within 48 hours of receiving your parcel.

Please provide:

  • Your order number.
  • A description of the issue.
  • Clear photographs of damaged products or packaging, where applicable.

Email: info@nailogy.co.uk

We will investigate the issue and arrange an appropriate solution, which may include replacement, refund or another remedy in accordance with applicable consumer law.

The suggested 48-hour reporting period does not limit your statutory rights.

7. RETURNING UNWANTED OR INCORRECTLY ORDERED GOODS

We understand that customers may occasionally wish to return products.

For most eligible online purchases, consumers have the right to cancel their order within 14 days of receiving the goods, without providing a reason.

Customers must then return the goods within 14 days of notifying us of cancellation.

Returned products should be handled only as necessary to inspect their nature, characteristics and functioning.

Where applicable, products should be returned with their original packaging and accessories.

Certain products may be excluded from change-of-mind returns where a statutory exception applies, including sealed products unsuitable for return for health protection or hygiene reasons once unsealed.

Customers are generally responsible for the direct cost of returning unwanted goods where this has been communicated before purchase.

Products that are faulty, damaged or not as described are covered by statutory consumer rights.

To request a return, please contact info@nailogy.co.uk.

8. CANCELLATION OF ORDER

Customers may request cancellation before an order has been dispatched.

If the order has already been dispatched, eligible consumer orders may still be cancelled under the applicable statutory cancellation rules.

Special-order products and professional equipment may be subject to additional conditions, depending on the nature of the product and applicable law.

We will communicate any relevant restrictions before purchase.

No cancellation or handling fees will be imposed where doing so would conflict with statutory consumer rights.

9. PRODUCT GUARANTEE AND WARRANTY

Products sold by Nailogy Shop UK may be covered by a manufacturer’s warranty, depending on the product and brand.

Warranty duration and conditions may vary.

Customers should follow manufacturer instructions regarding product use, storage and maintenance.

Damage caused by misuse, improper storage or unauthorised modification may not be covered by a manufacturer’s warranty.

Manufacturer warranties are provided in addition to, and do not replace, statutory consumer rights.

10. PROFESSIONAL USE AND PRODUCT SAFETY

Some products available through Nailogy Shop UK are intended exclusively for trained nail technicians and beauty professionals.

Professional products must be used according to the manufacturer’s instructions, safety warnings and recommended procedures.

Customers are responsible for ensuring they have the necessary training and knowledge to use professional products safely.

Nailogy Shop UK recommends appropriate hygiene practices, safe storage and correct handling of professional nail products and equipment.

Nothing in this section limits liability that cannot legally be excluded.

11. LIABILITY

Nailogy Shop UK aims to supply products that meet their descriptions and applicable quality and safety requirements.

We are not responsible for losses arising solely from incorrect product use, failure to follow manufacturer instructions or circumstances outside our reasonable control, except where liability cannot legally be excluded.

Nothing in these Terms & Conditions excludes or restricts liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud, fraudulent misrepresentation or any other liability that cannot legally be excluded.

Your statutory consumer rights remain unaffected.

12. OWNERSHIP OF GOODS

Ownership of goods remains with Nailogy Shop UK until full payment has been received.

Responsibility for goods purchased by consumers passes in accordance with applicable UK consumer law, generally when the goods come into the physical possession of the customer or a person identified by the customer to receive them.

13. ERRORS AND OMISSIONS

We make every effort to ensure that information published on our website is accurate.

Occasionally, errors may occur in product descriptions, prices, availability, promotions or other website content.

Nailogy Shop UK reserves the right to correct such errors and update information when necessary.

Where an error affects an order, we will contact the customer and handle the matter in accordance with applicable law.

14. CHANGES TO TERMS & CONDITIONS

Nailogy Shop UK reserves the right to update these Terms & Conditions to reflect changes in our products, services, business operations or legal requirements.

The latest version will be available on our website.

Changes will not retrospectively remove rights arising from previously accepted orders.

15. GOVERNING LAW

These Terms & Conditions are governed by the laws of England and Wales.

Nothing in these terms affects mandatory consumer protections that may apply elsewhere in the United Kingdom.

16. CONTACT DETAILS

For questions regarding orders, deliveries, returns, products or these Terms & Conditions, please contact us:
